previous_description: Contact information for the API owner or maintainer, including name, email, and URL. Enables consumers to reach out for support or collaboration.
definition: A metadata object nested in an API document's Info section that identifies the person or organisation responsible for the exposed API by name, email address and/or URL. It describes who maintains the API contract, not the server it is deployed on or the documentation it links to.

distinguish_from.when: the element carries the API's title, version, description or terms of service rather than only the maintainer's name, email and URL.
the URL points to a guide, wiki or reference material for the API rather than to a support or maintainer contact page.
the name and URL identify the legal licence terms under which the API is offered rather than the party to contact.

code_evidence: An info.contact block with name, email or url keys in an openapi.yaml or openapi.json file.
A framework OpenAPI configuration passing a contact argument, e.g. FastAPI(contact={...}), Springdoc new Contact().name(...).email(...), or a swagger-jsdoc definition.info.contact entry.
An @contact or @Contact annotation or docblock tag in API annotations, such as swag's // @contact.email comment or the MicroProfile @Contact(...) annotation inside @Info.

attribute_descriptions.name: url
attribute_descriptions.description: Absolute URL of the maintainer's support or contact page, e.g. https://example.com/support. Set it when consumers should reach the owner through a web page rather than, or as well as, by email.

attribute_descriptions.name: email
attribute_descriptions.description: Email address of the contact person or team, in RFC 5322 mailbox format, e.g. api-team@example.com. Set it when there is a monitored mailbox for API support or questions.

notes: The definition mentions 'name', but no name attribute is listed; add one, since OpenAPI Contact has name, url and email. The associated-with relationship to api.openapidocument duplicates the path through api.info aggregates. Consider removing it, because Contact is reachable only via Info in OpenAPI 3.0.
